title: NEO-GAS v2 defensive readiness baseline
summary: Baseline assessment of NEO-GAS as a defensive intelligence, resilience, cyber-defense governance, humanitarian-response, and crisis-planning platform using the GitHub repository as the versioned backend and GitHub Pages as the public frontend.

known: The repository contains a versioned NEO-GAS status model.
The Pages pipeline publishes a read-only NEO-GAS API snapshot.
The frontend is designed to prefer the Pages API and fall back to repository data.
unknown: Long-term operational availability of external public intelligence sources.
Future integration requirements for authenticated non-public data.
alternatives: Keep the public API entirely static and repository-backed.
Add a separately authenticated service later for non-public administrative data while preserving the public read layer.
defensiveOptions: Maintain source provenance on every assessment and indicator.
Require explicit confidence levels and timestamps.
Archive superseded records instead of rewriting historical assessments.
